selected_issue.title: Writes are dropped if tee object is closed too soon

observed_code_path.drain: close writer pipe; immediately send SIGINT to tee process; wait
observed_code_path.risk: pending pipe bytes can be discarded when the reader process is interrupted before natural EOF drain completes

recommended_fix: restore original stdout and stderr file descriptors
close the tee writer ends to deliver EOF
wait for the tee reader process to exit naturally
only after a bounded timeout send SIGTERM or SIGINT, then SIGKILL as a last resort
make close idempotent and clear stored pipe/process handles
required_regression_tests: immediate close after one write without sleep
many stdout and stderr writes followed by immediate close
combined output preserves ordering and completeness within documented guarantees
hung child process follows timeout escalation without indefinite wait
